content.short: Hyperion is a high-performance hybrid Orderbook-AMM DEX on Aptos featuring concentrated liquidity and vaults.
content.description:
Hyperion is a professional-grade decentralized exchange built natively on the Aptos blockchain, utilizing a hybrid Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) and AMM architecture. This dual model combines the precision and liquidity of traditional order books with the accessibility of automated market makers, allowing for efficient trade execution and minimal slippage. By leveraging Aptos's parallel execution and high throughput, Hyperion provides a high-performance trading environment with sub-second finality.

In addition to its core exchange features, Hyperion offers concentrated liquidity (CLMM) for liquidity providers and automated yield vaults to maximize capital efficiency. The platform is designed to cater to both retail and institutional traders, providing a non-custodial and transparent venue for asset exchange that rivals the speed of centralized platforms while maintaining the core benefits of decentralized finance.
